subjects.DW1-H01-kitten: the cutest Domowik of all: a tiny, round, extra-fluffy little house spirit, like a soft plush toy come to life, with a big soft round pink nose, huge gentle heavy-lidded green eyes with a sweet shy look, rosy cheeks, fluffy silver-grey eyebrows, a short, very fluffy cloud-like grey beard, soft fur on his little arms and big furry bare feet, wearing a small white linen shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery and a tiny red woven belt. Same character design as the Domowiki in the reference, only smaller, rounder, softer and even more adorable. Not Santa Claus, no hat, no crown, no halo, no glowing robes. He sits on the warm ledge of a whitewashed clay stove, hugging a small round loaf of bread almost as big as himself, a tiny lilac hedgehog snuggled against him and a little green cricket peeking from behind the loaf, a glowing ember beside them. Cosy, tender, captivating.
subjects.DW1-H01-bigcat: the cutest Domowik of all: a tiny, round, extra-fluffy little house spirit, like a soft plush toy come to life, with a big soft round pink nose, huge gentle heavy-lidded green eyes with a sweet shy look, rosy cheeks, fluffy silver-grey eyebrows, a short, very fluffy cloud-like grey beard, soft fur on his little arms and big furry bare feet, wearing a small white linen shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery and a tiny red woven belt. Same character design as the Domowiki in the reference, only smaller, rounder, softer and even more adorable. Not Santa Claus, no hat, no crown, no halo, no glowing robes. Now he is the proud little master of the house: he stands on top of the warm stove with his tiny chest puffed out and a content smile, holding a little wooden spoon like a sceptre, while a lilac hedgehog, a green cricket and a grey kitten sit around him looking up at him adoringly. A clay pot of porridge steams beside him. Cosy, proud and funny, still tiny and adorable.
subjects.DW1-D01: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem. He sits on the warm ledge of a whitewashed clay stove with a glowing fire opening, hugging a round loaf of dark bread, a sleepy furry little creature snuggled against him, a glowing ember beside him on the bricks.
subjects.DW1-D02: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem. He rides inside a big old worn leather boot hanging from a rope, hugging a clay pot of glowing embers, with a straw broom, a red bundle and a blue polka-dot sack tied to the boot, and a little lilac hedgehog peeking out of the boot.
subjects.DW1-D03: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem. At night in a stable, he sits on the back of a big gentle brown horse, happily braiding its long mane into neat little plaits tied with red ribbons, the horse looking back at him calmly. Moonlight through the stable boards.
subjects.DW1-D04: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem, very old, his beard reaching the floor. He sits on a wooden threshold in a doorway painted blue with red folk flowers, arms crossed, looking wise and stern, a lilac hedgehog peeking over his shoulder and a little green cricket at his side.
subjects.DW1-D05: Ovinnik, the spirit of the grain-drying barn: a big, shaggy, disheveled black spirit like an enormous fluffy black cat, with glowing ember-orange eyes, a grumpy but lovable face and whiskers dusted with chaff. He sits curled on top of a warm clay oven inside an old wooden threshing barn full of sheaves of golden rye hung up to dry, glowing embers in the oven below him, a little clay dish of porridge left for him at the foot of the oven, which he pointedly ignores. Cute, grumpy, captivating.
subjects.DW1-D06: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem. He stands in an open wooden doorway welcoming a guest, holding out a round braided loaf of bread with a little bowl of salt on top, resting on an embroidered white towel, a small grey kitten peeking from behind his legs.
subjects.DW1-D07: Kikimora, the Domowik's wife: a small, thin, bird-like old woman house spirit with a long nose, bright beady eyes, wild grey hair in a headscarf with red embroidery, and a patched linen dress. She sits by the stove at night spinning wool on a wooden distaff and spindle, the glowing thread curling into the air like a silver trail, a sly knowing smile.
subjects.DW1-D08: Dvorovoi, the spirit of the farmyard: a big, broad, shaggy old man house spirit, much larger than a Domowik, covered in thick brown-grey fur like a sheepdog, with a huge beard full of straw, a big pink nose and kind green eyes, wearing a coarse linen shirt with red embroidery. He stands in a moonlit farmyard by a wattle fence and a well, a hen, a goat and a horse gathered around him, the cottage windows glowing behind.
subjects.DW1-D09: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem. He sits at the foot of the stove eating from a steaming clay bowl of buckwheat porridge with melting butter, holding a big wooden spoon, eyes closed with pure happiness.
subjects.DW1-D10: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem, but furious: his beard and hair bristling, cheeks red, stamping his furry feet on the kitchen shelf, clay pots and pans tumbling and clanging, a spoon flying through the air, sparks from the stove. Funny, not scary.
subjects.DW1-D11: a small Domowik house spirit: a chubby, gentle little old man, as tall as a cat, with a huge soft round pink nose, heavy-lidded sleepy green eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long shaggy grey-silver beard and hair, a soft coat of fur on his arms and legs, and big furry bare feet, wearing a white linen Slavic shirt with red cross-stitch embroidery on the cuffs and hem. In a cosy barn at night he sets down a saucer of warm milk on the straw, a happy cow, a goat and a cat gathering to it, soft lantern light.
subjects.DW1-D12: An old, worn woven bast shoe (a Slavic lapot, woven from strips of birch bark) lined with straw, sitting on a wooden floor by the stove, a soft warm glow coming from inside it and a few glowing embers beside it, as if something small lives there. A tiny furry hand and a grey beard just visible over the rim.
subjects.DW1-D13: A big fluffy grey-and-white house cat sitting on the warm stove, but its shadow on the whitewashed wall behind it is the shadow of a little bearded old man with a big nose. The cat has the same heavy-lidded, wise green eyes as the Domowik. Warm ember light.
subjects.DW1-D14: Babunia, the Domowik's wife and the grandmother of the house: an adorable, tiny, round old woman house spirit, the same character design as the Domowiki in the reference but female: a big soft round pink nose, gentle heavy-lidded green eyes with a warm knowing smile, rosy cheeks, soft fluffy silver-grey hair peeking out from a red headscarf embroidered with folk flowers, soft fur on her little arms and big furry bare feet, a white linen blouse with red cross-stitch embroidery and a woven apron. She stands proudly on the stone steps of a cosy cellar, holding up a glowing jar of cherry preserves, surrounded by shelves full of jars of pickles, honey and jam, strings of onions and a basket of apples, a candle glowing warmly, a lilac hedgehog peeking from behind a barrel. Cosy, lovable, captivating. Not a witch, not scary.
subjects.DW1-D15: Bannik, the spirit of the bathhouse: a wiry, wild-haired old man house spirit with a long wet grey beard, red cheeks and a big pink nose, fierce bright eyes and a mischievous grin, wearing only a linen towel. He sits on the top bench of a steamy wooden Slavic bathhouse, holding a bundle of birch twigs, thick billowing clouds of glowing steam around him.
subjects.DW1-D16: A small, cheerful green house cricket with big friendly eyes and long antennae, singing on a warm brick at the foot of a glowing clay stove, a tiny wooden bowl of crumbs beside it.
subjects.DW1-D17: The house snake: a small, friendly grass snake (glossy dark olive with two bright yellow patches behind its head), curled up under an old wooden doorstep painted with red folk flowers, happily sipping from a little saucer of milk left out for it, with big gentle round eyes and a content expression. Warm candlelight from the doorway above, a few bread crumbs by the saucer. Cute and friendly, not scary.
subjects.DW1-D18: Kłobuk, a little Polish household spirit that looks like a completely soaked, bedraggled black chick: a small round fluffy black bird with droopy wet feathers, huge shining golden eyes and a pitiful, hopeful expression, sitting on a wooden wattle fence in the pouring rain at night. Behind it the warm glowing window of a cottage, and a pair of small hands in embroidered sleeves reaching out of the doorway to take it in. Tiny grains of wheat and a single gold coin stuck to its wet feathers. Adorable, funny, captivating.
subjects.DW1-D19: Close-up of a sleeping child in a wooden bed under an embroidered quilt, a soft, warm, furry little hand gently resting on their cheek, glowing with a golden warm light, the child smiling in their sleep. Only the small furry hand and arm of the house spirit are visible, reaching from the dark.
subjects.DW1-D20: At night in a stable, a big grumpy horse with its long mane tangled into a wild messy bird's nest of knots, with a tiny furry grey-bearded Domowik tugging mischievously on the knots, the horse rolling its eyes.
